description: USD accrued and claimed per recipient kind (agent, creator, burn, platform, and recipient for a Clanker v5 coin’s extra reward rows) for one coin. A kind answers null when its share cannot be told apart from another held by the same wallet. On Clanker v5 it also names the paired asset the fees are paid in (pairedSymbol), each side’s tax in millionths of the trade (15000 = 1.5%) and the holder dividends, which holders withdraw themselves.
name: bootr_coin_fees
title: Coin fees
